name: 37th Bangkok Marathon
short_description: The 37th Bangkok Marathon takes place on January 10, 2027, beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand.
ai_summary: The 37th Bangkok Marathon is scheduled for January 10, 2027, taking place on Sanam Chai Road beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand. The event offers three distances: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km race. Nationwide registration has not yet opened and is set to begin on July 1, 2026.

core_facts.venue: Sanam Chai Road, beside the Grand Palace, Bangkok

faqs.question: When is the 37th Bangkok Marathon?
faqs.answer: The 37th Bangkok Marathon is scheduled to take place on January 10, 2027. This date marks the running of the race, which will be held in Bangkok, Thailand, at a venue beside the historic Grand Palace on Sanam Chai Road.

faqs.question: Where does the race start?
faqs.answer: The race starts on Sanam Chai Road, located beside the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand. This central, historic location places runners near one of the city's most iconic landmarks as they begin their race.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: The 37th Bangkok Marathon offers three race distances for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, and a shorter 10 km race, catering to a range of runner abilities.

faqs.question: When does registration open?
faqs.answer: Registration for the 37th Bangkok Marathon has not yet opened. According to available information, nationwide registration is planned to begin on July 1, 2026, ahead of the race date of January 10, 2027.
